blurb: Blackwater Nordic Club provides cross-country skiing opportunities including a Bill Koch Youth League for children grades K-6. Members can ski on groomed trails at Hopkinton State Fairgrounds and Gould Hill Farm. The club offers events, races, and ski instruction in classic and skate styles.
extraNote: Online registration available through Oasys Sports with credit card or check payment · Waiver must be signed electronically during registration · Fairgrounds entrance from the Odd Fellows parking lot (513 Park Avenue, Contoocook) for Bill Koch Youth League; Houston Fields if snow cover is poor
